device.description: 10-bit 20 MSPS +3 V pipelined ADC with external references and parallel CMOS outputs
device.note: ads901.pdf (SBAS054A) p.2-3 electrical characteristics (rising-edge convert clock, 5-clock latency, straight offset binary, 3-state enable 40 ns / disable 10 ns max, +VS 2.7-3.7 V), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, timing diagram (t2 new data delay 12 ns max), p.8 output coding and OE, p.10 coding Table I, p.11 digital outputs (LVDD) and power-down mode (Pwrdn high = power down)

pages: p.2-3 (specifications), p.4 (pins, timing), p.8 (output coding, OE), p.10 (Table I), p.11 (digital outputs, LVDD, power-down)
notModeled: analog input and external references REFT/REFB (single-ended input range REFB..REFT, 1-2 V nominal); a 0 V input is below -FS and reads 000h (straight offset binary has 0 at REFB), so codeFormat is straight
pipeline latency of 5 clock cycles (the code is constant)
clock period / duty-cycle limits (50 ns to 100 us) and aperture delay

two supplies: +VS 2.7-3.7 V (analog core and CLK/OE/Pwrdn inputs) and LVDD (output drivers); the datasheet gives no LVDD range (specified at LVDD = +3 V), so vcc is the +VS range and +VS is listed under analog so LVDD is the digital supply
3-state disable time printed as 18 ns typ / 10 ns max (inconsistent); tFloat uses the 10 ns max; enable time 40 ns max; internal 50 kOhm pull-downs on OE and Pwrdn
power-down (Pwrdn high): the ADS901 datasheet does not state the output state while powered down (the ADS900 sets them 3-state)
